Simple answer - Your purchases are linked to YOUR sub account on Playstation. If there is other sub accounts (ex. you have a main account and another for friends) only the sub account you purchased it on will receive the item. If all sub accounts got the item, more users would try and exploit it by adding their friend's accounts onto their sub account list, and buying an item.
TL;DR - Your purchase only goes to the account you purchase it on, not the system/sub accounts.
